players.product: synthetic DNA, proteins, antibody libraries, and characterization data

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K fiscal 2025 (year ended September 30, 2025) revenue by product, XBRL: Synthetic genes $113.6M (+22.6% YoY), Oligo pools $20.2M (+19.7%), DNA libraries $11.2M (-19.7%), Antibody discovery $23.5M (+15.4%) and NGS tools $208.1M (+23.0%); total revenues rose 20%. Healthcare customers provided 57% of revenue (54% in fiscal 2024). Gross margin was 50.7% versus 42.6%. Twist shipped 938 thousand genes versus 772 thousand, and 99% of revenue came from repeat customers. No customer accounted for 10% or more of revenue in fiscal 2025, 2024 or 2023.
quarterly_data.figure: Synthetic genes $113.6M (+22.6%); Antibody discovery $23.5M (+15.4%); NGS tools $208.1M (+23.0%); revenue +20%; gross margin 50.7%; 938 thousand genes shipped

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K biopharma partnerships: as of September 30, 2025 Twist had signed 442 revenue-generating partnerships, with 1182 completed programs and 84 active programs, 82 of which include milestones and/or royalties. Partners named include Bayer, Boehringer Ingelheim, Takeda, Adicet Bio, Ono Pharmaceutical, Kyowa Kirin, Invetx, Astellas and Neogene Therapeutics.
quarterly_data.figure: 442 revenue-generating partnerships; 1182 completed and 84 active programs

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K manufacturing and supply: Twist manufactures all of its products and multiple sub-assemblies at its South San Francisco, California and Wilsonville, Oregon facilities, has consolidated all synthetic biology production in Wilsonville and outsources some sub-assemblies to third-party manufacturers; it employed 412 people in manufacturing and operations. It depends on one single-source supplier, under a supply agreement, for a critical component of its DNA synthesis process. Commitments for capital expenditures were $17.5 million as of September 30, 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: 412 manufacturing and operations staff; capex commitments $17.5 million
